“Wolf And The Queen” is the fourth single taken from the Shadowborne debut album “Heaven's Falling” to be released on June 19 by Scarlet Records – “Wolf And The Queen” explores a hidden bond between two powerful figures from opposing worlds. Set against a backdrop of war and destiny, the song captures stolen moments above the clouds – freedom found in secrecy. Beneath its soaring atmosphere lies tension: love entangled with prophecy, loyalty tested by desire. It reflects the fragile space where vulnerability meets power, and where passion must remain unspoken

“Interstellar Madness” is the third single/titletrack taken from the new Moonlight Haze EP to be released on May 22 by Scarlet Records 

«A whirlwind of emotions, accompanied by the most epic melodies the band has written so far, by long instrumental parts and evocative choir sections. This song shows how compelling it can be to get carried away by the deepest feelings, letting rationality rest for a while in order to discover sides of the inner self never dared to be acknowledged before. That is part of the process that leads to the creation of new Art»

“18 (It Feels Like Heaven)” is the first single taken from the new Vision Divine EP “A Clockwork Reverie” to be released on May 22 by Scarlet Records – a man walks through the desert and meets an old stranger who tells him, «I’ve been waiting for you.» – the man doesn’t recall any appointment. The old man explains that they were meant to meet 18 years ago – for reasons unknown, it never happened. So he waited. The man then wakes up. It was all a dream. But as he walks through the city, lost in thought, he sees the same old man standing at a street corner – turning, as if expecting him

“Moonlight Legion” is the first single taken from the new Moonlight Haze EP “Interstellar Madness” to be released on May 22 by Scarlet Records 

«We drew inspiration for “Moonlight Legion” from everything we’ve lived through over the years with the people who’ve been part of this band’s journey from day one. The energy we get from the crowd at our shows, and the constant support we feel even offstage, made us realize early on that we’re part of something truly special and unique – with this music video, we wanted to capture that feeling, showing real moments from the life we share with them. These are exciting, fun, and genuinely meaningful experiences – reminders of how much this journey is worth because of the people who are part of it, and how good it feels to live it together»

“Reborn To Light” is the third single taken from the eponymous new Aeon Gods album to be released on February 20 by Scarlet Records – after facing chaos, serpents, and the shadows of dissolution, the sun-god rises again. The song captures this moment of cosmic victory with a powerful metal hymn: driving riffs, thunderous drums, and an anthemic chorus that celebrates the defeat of the evil forces seeking to extinguish creation. “Reborn To Light” is both a mythic climax and a musical declaration – epic, uplifting, and forged in the heart of ancient legend. No matter how deep the night, dawn will always rise again

Music and lyrics by Alexander Hunzinger
Published by Scarlet Records Srl

“The Illusionist (Raise The Curtain)” is the first single taken from the new Evermore album “Mournbraid” to be released on March 20 by Scarlet Records – deception is a performance and every lie is a scripted line. “The Illusionist (Raise The Curtain)” explores the hollow life of a social manipulator, drawing a haunting parallel between a backstabber and a fading stage magician. As the performer relies on cheap tricks and shallow illusions to maintain their status, the audience slowly sees through the act. One by one, friends depart and trust dissolves, leaving the spotlight to shine on nothing but an empty room

Music and lyrics by Andreas Viklands & Johan Karlsson
Published by Scarlet Records Srl
Video by Stefano Mastronicola

Lyrics:

You play the role of victim perfectly
An artist of hypocrisy
Action, scene!

Put the mask of virtue on and go on blaming everyone you meet;
For your own deeds

Spin a web of lies and see how everyone around agrees
You plead; amnesty

It’s time to start the show, here we go, a magic display

Raise the curtain
Final scene
May your last trick be the best ever seen
Cast a spell, magical tears
And the whole crowd disappears

Use your dirty tricks and schemes to conjure up some self-esteem
You scream; all eyes on me
Slowly will the traitor learn, you play with fire and bridges burn
Disposed; how’s that feel?

You run a one-man show, so let’s go, come blow us away

Raise the curtain
Turn around
Not a single person left to be found
Magic’s gone, genuine tears
As you slowly disappear

When there’s nothing left to hide
When you stand alone with guilt and no pride
Seek forgiveness but it is too late
No return
You realize

The curtain has fallen
Kill the lights
Just a fading star in the dark of the night
When it’s over, when it’s too late
Such a sad and lonely fate
